cues: Carbon dioxide, sulphur dioxide, aluminium chloride and boron trifluoride all act as acids, but contain no hydrogen to give.
Ammonia and sodium carbonate are bases, but have no hydroxide group.
Dry hydrogen chloride gas does not even redden dry litmus.
The water is an active partner, not a spectator.
